definitions.booster: a dose of a vaccine increasing or renewing the effect of an earlier one.
definitions.bore: make (a hole) in something with a drill or other tool.
definitions.ore: a naturally occurring solid material from which a metal or valuable mineral can be extracted profitably.
definitions.rest: cease work or movement in order to relax or recover strength.
definitions.rob: take property unlawfully from (a person or place) by force or threat of force.
definitions.robe: a long, loose outer garment reaching to the ankles.
definitions.robot: a machine capable of carrying out a complex series of actions automatically, especially one programmable by a computer.
definitions.roe: (also hard roe) the mass of eggs contained in the ovaries of a female fish or shellfish, especially when ripe and used as food.
definitions.roost: a place where birds regularly settle to rest at night, or where bats congregate to rest in the day.
definitions.root: a part of a plant normally below ground, which acts as a support and collects water and nourishment.
definitions.rose: a prickly bush or shrub that typically bears red, pink, yellow, or white fragrant flowers, native to north temperate regions and widely grown as an ornamental.
definitions.rot: decompose by the action of bacteria and fungi; decay.
definitions.sober: not affected by alcohol; not drunk.
definitions.sort: a category of people or things with a common feature.
definitions.store: a quantity or supply kept for use as needed.
definitions.strobe: a lamp that produces regular bright flashes of light.
definitions.tore: a surface or solid resembling a ring doughnut, formed by rotating a closed curve about a line which lies in the same plane but does not intersect it.
definitions.torso: the trunk of the human body.
